en: In Hosea 3, besides silver, what did Hosea pay for the woman?
In Hosea 5, God pours out his wrath like what?
In Hosea 7, Israel is like which treacherous weapon?
In Hosea 8, what will God send upon Judah's cities?
In Hosea 9, Israel will become what among the nations?
In Hosea 9, Israel's bread will be like whose bread?
In Hosea 10, what will people beg to cover them?
In Hosea 10, who were dashed to pieces with their children?
In Hosea 10, since the days of which town has Israel sinned?
In Hosea 11, God drew Israel with bands of what?
In Hosea 13, idolaters worship images of which animal?
In Hosea 13, besides cloud, dew and chaff, Israel vanishes like what?
In Hosea 13, what kind of pains come upon Ephraim?
